name: 70 - DB - Add Patient Profiles Documents and Previsit Guidance

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_profiles (
    patient_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    email TEXT,
    date_of_birth DATE,
    preferred_language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fa'
        CHECK (preferred_language IN ('fa','en','ar','unknown')),
    emergency_contact_name TEXT,
    emergency_contact_mobile TEXT,
    address_text TEXT,
    consent_to_contact BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    consent_to_store_profile BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    consent_to_store_documents BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    privacy_notice_version TEXT,
    privacy_notice_accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    profile_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
        CHECK (profile_status IN ('active','inactive','merged','archived')),
    notes TEXT,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_profile_changes (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    changed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    change_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'api'
        CHECK (change_source IN ('patient','secretary','doctor','admin','api','import','system')),
    before_data JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    after_data JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    changed_fields JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_documents (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    appointment_id BIGINT REFERENCES appointments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    document_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (document_type IN (
            'insurance_card','prescription','lab_result','imaging','referral',
            'medical_report','consent_form','identification','pre_visit_form','other'
        )),
    source_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'web'
        CHECK (source_channel IN ('web','whatsapp','telegram','email','manual','api')),
    original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
    mime_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_size_bytes BIGINT CHECK (file_size_bytes IS NULL OR file_size_bytes >= 0),
    storage_provider TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'external',
    storage_key TEXT,
    file_url TEXT,
    checksum_sha256 TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_review'
        CHECK (status IN (
            'uploaded','processing','pending_review','approved','rejected',
            'reupload_required','archived','failed'
        )),
    extracted_text TEXT,
    extraction_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_requested'
        CHECK (extraction_status IN ('not_requested','pending','completed','failed')),
    contains_sensitive_health_information BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    consent_to_store BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    reviewed_by TEXT,
    reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    review_note TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_patient_document_checksum
ON patient_documents(clinic_id, patient_id, checksum_sha256)
WHERE checksum_sha256 IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_document_actions (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    document_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES patient_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    action_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (action_type IN (
            'uploaded','claimed','processing_started','text_extracted',
            'approved','rejected','reupload_requested','archived','failed'
        )),
    actor_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_note TEXT,
    action_metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointment_previsit_guidance (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    appointment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES appointments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    version_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version_number >= 1),
    language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fa' CHECK (language IN ('fa','en','ar')),
    guidance_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    checklist JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
    citations JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generated'
        CHECK (status IN ('generated','sent','acknowledged','needs_clarification','archived')),
    generated_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'rag',
    generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    patient_response TEXT,
    clarification_note TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE (appointment_id, version_number)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_patient_profile_changes
ON patient_profile_changes(patient_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_patient_documents_review
ON patient_documents(clinic_id, status, created_at DESC)
WHERE status IN ('uploaded','processing','pending_review','reupload_required');

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_patient_documents_patient
ON patient_documents(patient_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_previsit_guidance_appointment
ON appointment_previsit_guidance(appointment_id, version_number DESC);

SELECT TRUE AS success,
       'migration_completed' AS result,
       'ساختار پروفایل بیمار، مدارک بیمار و راهنمای پیش از مراجعه ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

پروفایل بیمار، تاریخچه تغییرات، مدارک بیمار و راهنمای پیش از مراجعه ایجاد می‌شوند.

فایل واقعی در PostgreSQL ذخیره نمی‌شود؛ فقط URL یا Storage Key آن نگهداری می‌شود.
